svg.title: Chat moderation with Amazon Nova Micro
svg.desc: The Kustamie app talks to Amazon IVS Chat over WebSocket; other interactive features on Amazon ECS and AWS Lambda post to IVS Chat too. Chat messages flow through Amazon Data Firehose into Amazon DynamoDB, whose stream triggers an AWS Lambda function that invokes a model on Amazon Bedrock, writes a status update back to DynamoDB and sends a delete message request to IVS Chat. Staff review the chat content in DynamoDB.
